name: Get File Public URL
description: Get a publicly available URL for a file that was uploaded using a Hubspot form. [See the documentation](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/api/files/files#endpoint?spec=GET-/files/v3/files/{fileId}/signed-url)

configurable_props.name: fileUrl
configurable_props.label: File URL
configurable_props.description: The URL returned after a file has been uploaded to a HubSpot Form

configurable_props.name: expirationSeconds
configurable_props.label: Public URL Expiration (seconds)
configurable_props.description: The number of seconds the returned public URL will be accessible for. Default is 1 hour (3600 seconds). Maximum is 6 hours (21600 seconds).
